001package dev.nandi0813.api.Interface;
002
003import org.bukkit.entity.Player;
004import org.bukkit.plugin.Plugin;
005
006import java.util.List;
007
008/**
009 * Thread-safe. Registered decorators are applied to every rendered player name.
010 */
011public interface NameDecorationRegistry {
012
013    /**
014     * Register a name decorator.
015     * @param owner The plugin that owns the decorator
016     * @param decorator The decorator
017     * @throws IllegalArgumentException if the id is already registered or invalid.
018     */
019    void register(Plugin owner, NameDecorator decorator);
020
021    /**
022     * Unregister a name decorator.
023     * @param id The decorator id
024     * @return true if a decorator with this id was registered
025     */
026    boolean unregister(String id);
027
028    /**
029     * Unregister every decorator of a plugin.
030     * Called automatically by the core when {@code owner} is disabled.
031     * @param owner The plugin
032     */
033    void unregisterAll(Plugin owner);
034
035    /**
036     * Unmodifiable snapshot, ordered by priority.
037     * @return The registered decorators, never null
038     */
039    List<NameDecorator> getDecorators();
040
041    /**
042     * Re-render the player's nametag and tab name, e.g. after a decorator's output changed.
043     * Sidebar and chat pick up changes automatically. Main thread only.
044     * @param player The player
045     */
046    void refresh(Player player);
047
048}
